_comment: Manifest corrections with provenance. Each entry records WHY the change was made and where the claim came from, so it can be re-reviewed. Applied by tools/apply_corrections.py. Verify before trusting: a repository name found by web search is a strong hint, not proof that it is the same mod your WeiDU.log installed.

corrections.reason: was cleartext http:// to a dead-ish pocketplane CMS URL; mod migrated to GitHub
corrections.evidence: https://github.com/Pocket-Plane-Group/Lure_Of_Sirines_Call - repo confirmed, publishes releases, contains a 'SirinesCall' folder matching the WeiDU log

corrections.reason: was cleartext http:// to shsforums file page; SHS mods migrated to GitHub
corrections.evidence: https://github.com/Spellhold-Studios/FishingForTrouble - repo confirmed (github.com/InfinityMods/FishingForTrouble redirects here), publishes releases, folder 'FishingForTrouble' matches the WeiDU log

corrections.reason: url pointed at a GitHub USER PROFILE (github.com/Glittergear), not a repository, and 'github' was null - the entry could never resolve

cleartext http://. No GitHub mirror of the ROMANCE mod exists - SpellholdStudios/HaerdalisFriendship is a DIFFERENT mod with a different tp2 and must not be substituted. Only the URL scheme is changed.
corrections.evidence: UNVERIFIED: shsforums.net is blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so https support could not be confirmed. If https fails, the tool reports MANUAL rather than silently falling back to http.

set.notes: https scheme unverified; if resolution fails, download manually from the SHS file page
